text:
jordy: noticed a spike in quota hits for premium customers tied to the new header-rewrite rule, digging in :eyes:
maya: saw the same from the cost dashboard, premium token rate jumped at 17:04 UTC
sam: is this the rule that normalizes `X-Customer-Tier` to `X-User-Tier`? that landed in canary last night
jordy: yeah, looks like the rewrite strips `X-User-Tier` for proxied requests, so quota lookup falls back to default plan
maya: ops-bot created INC-2026 for this (link: https://redwoodops/INC-2026)
ops-bot: incident INC-2026 created, severity=P2, assigned=@maya
maya: i'm going to flip the routing rule to the previous behavior (no rewrite) — will do a quick toggle in console and watch
deploy-bot: received toggle request: route-rule-id=rw-9f2a, action=disable-rewrite, requested_by=maya
prod-gw-bot: applying change to 3 regions: us-west1, eu-central1, ap-south-1
maya: flipped it in console, status=applied (us-west1), watching metrics
jordy: seeing immediate drop in erroneous metric counts, premium_ok now back to baseline :thumbsup:
sam: can we confirm no more drift in quota enforcement? run a few synthetic premium requests
lee: running a small synthetic batch now: `for i in {1..50}; do curl -H "X-User-Tier: premium" https://api.redwood/v1/generate; done`
lee: all 50 passed premium quota checks, good
maya: ops-bot, can you document the rollback steps we just used for the runbook
ops-bot: rollback steps appended to INC-2026: 1) toggle rw-9f2a rewrite off in console 2) validate synthetic premium requests 3) monitor dashboards for 10m 4) file RCA
sam: needs root cause patch — looks like header canonicalization code assumed `X-User-Tier` was present and stripped other headers when doing merge. will prepare a fix for runtime to preserve original headers and add tests
jordy: devex/console UX note: toggles are too easy to change in prod without a brief justification and reviewer. propose making emergency toggles require a 1-click justification that gets saved to audit + optional 2nd approver for P1/P2
lee: also propose a short-lived dry-run mode for route-rule changes (evaluate effect, don't apply) so we can see metric impact before flipping
maya: agree. for now, adding an entry to the rollback playbook to include a quick dry-run checklist and who to ping
prod-gw-bot: change complete in eu-central1 and ap-south-1, total time=38s
jordy: leaving INC-2026 assigned to sam for code patch + to lee for console UX follow-up
sam: will open a PR with test coverage, target patch release tomorrow morning
lee: will file a small console change request: require justification text + add dry-run toggle + record approver when severity>=P2
maya: thanks all. leaving the channel for now, will update once RCA is drafted
jordy: thumbs up, closing monitoring window in 30m. great coordination everyone :clap:
